freeze_scope: Hypothesis, selection rule, checkpoint identities and workload bounds; acquisition coordinates and executable preprocessing remain unresolved.
hypothesis: The released native-resolution iteration-5 ablation produces more source-supported coherent stroke structure on l_5 than iteration 0 under the same audited inference recipe.

scope.purpose: Bounded reproduction of the June 2026 ablation's visibility comparison, with a separate l_2 adaptation sanity control.
excluded_substitutions: The pooled 9.596-micrometer PHerc1667/w013 control is not a native June-model input.
PHerc0800's eligible 8.640-micrometer volume is a separate transfer problem.
Released ablation checkpoints are not established as the final three-column full-scroll detector.

sections: Methods: ink detection training and adaptation

l_5.role: Native reference visibility comparison, held out from l_2 adaptation supervision in the reported ablation
l_5.label_status: Paper Table 2 reports inference only, no labels; no independent evaluation labels acquired.

l_2.role: Separate adaptation/training sanity control; excluded from l_5 conclusions

selection_rule.freeze_before: Loading checkpoint predictions or choosing favorable image structures
selection_rule.l_5_strata: Split the geometry-valid source bounding box into three equal-height native-Y bands; choose one crop with its center in each band.
selection_rule.stratum_center_definition: X midpoint of the global geometry-valid bounding box and Y midpoint of the band's bounds; distance is squared Euclidean distance in native pixels.

candidate_requirements.verified_selected_depth_payload_coverage: All required source support observed and recorded; declared missing/fill support must be distinguished and excluded.

ranking: Higher count of fully valid 256-pixel tiles
Smaller distance between crop center and its stratum center
l_5_data_permitted_for_selection: Native CT coordinates and render provenance
selection_rule.l_2_sanity_selection: One eligible crop selected from verified l_2 label support before model outputs; freeze the exact criterion and coordinates in the acquisition manifest. Label bytes/alignment are presently unresolved.
selection_rule.failure_policy: Record insufficient coverage or physical overlap. Do not relax the rule or replace regions after inspecting predictions; use a separately versioned plan for changed selection.

inference_recipe.architecture: ResNet3D-50 encoder, per-stage depth maximum, 2D U-Net decoder
inference_recipe.known_direction_evidence: Iteration-0 card explicitly says reverse_layers=True for l_2; this does not establish the l_5 convention or every checkpoint/segment pairing.

intensity_preprocessing.conflict: Cards suggest approximately [0,1], tiling examples feed raw float layers, wrapper header says z-score normalized, and paper says clip [0,200] then Normalize(mean=0,std=1). The exact dtype/divisor is not established by retained artifacts.
intensity_preprocessing.resolution_rule: Resolve against the original pinned training/inference transforms and runtime behavior, without selecting preprocessing by favorable predictions.

inference_recipe.padding: None within the fixed 1024-square crop; starts 0,128,...,768 in each axis.
inference_recipe.fragment_mask_gate: Skip any tile containing any zero fragment-mask pixel, as documented by the released cards.
inference_recipe.output_transform: Sigmoid logits, then bilinear 4x upsampling, then uniform averaging over overlapping accepted tiles; no Hann weighting.
inference_recipe.bilinear_align_corners_blocker: Card example omits the argument; pin the exact runtime/default and make the adapter convention explicit before execution.
inference_recipe.checkpoint_load: Pinned safetensors, reviewed local model/configuration sources, strict state match with no missing/unexpected keys; no floating-revision remote-code execution.

workload_bounds.bounded_request_rule: Verify metadata and count actual required source objects/chunks before acquisition. Whole-segment TIFF downloads or a request plan exceeding these bounds require a revised plan.

analysis.common_domain: Same geometry-valid and observed source support, evaluated by both iterations, with a 128-pixel crop-edge margin; exclude pixels affected by any contributing tile with invalid geometry or missing required depth support.
analysis.physical_support_audit: Use mesh/native CT coordinates to record overlap between l_5 contexts, l_2 adaptation material and pretraining aliases. Disjoint render coordinates or different segment IDs do not establish independent physical samples.
analysis.blinded_review: Randomize iteration panel identities; inspect identical fixed-scale source depth panels, native CT placement and surrounding context before revealing checkpoint identity. Record coherent stroke support, ambiguity and disagreement, without prompting text identities.
permitted_quantitative_summaries: Paired absolute changes and descriptive spatial correspondence
analysis.accuracy_metrics_blocker: No independently verified l_5 evaluation labels; precision, recall, F1 and calibrated target confidence cannot be computed.
analysis.allowed_conclusion: A bounded replication of reported visibility behavior under an explicitly audited recipe.
prohibited_conclusions: All-pretraining independence from l_2 exclusion alone
Verified final full-scroll June pipeline reproduction

gpu_pilot_contract.launch_rule: This scientific-plan is not an executable GPU job. Remain not ready until audited immutable inputs/adapter/image, a bounded quote/runtime within the shared GBP 10 ceiling, and independently verified shutdown are recorded in a separate operational contract.

blockers.needed: Exact public l_5/l_2 source IDs, versions, native spacing, layer quantization, geometry masks and original render correspondence.
Map paper layer names 1-62 and depth direction to each exact source/checkpoint pairing; do not assume a current 109-layer public render matches the original 65-position paper sampling.
Audited original preprocessing resolving clipping, dtype and normalization divisor/centering.
Review the pinned configuration source, strict-load adapter, interpolation default, package lock and image digest; weight payloads remain undownloaded/unverified.
Freeze geometry/coverage-selected coordinates, physical-support mapping, payload/mask hashes and a bounded source request plan before inference.
Exact l_2_inklabels5.png bytes/alignment for the separate sanity control; keep it outside l_5 conclusions.
Account for all pilot spending/commitments, obtain a bounded quote/runtime and verify independent shutdown within the aggregate GBP 10 authorization.
